newsitem.title: USA: U.S. House panel sets electric hearing for June 19.
newsitem.headline: U.S. House panel sets electric hearing for June 19.

text.p: The U.S. House energy and power subcommittee plans to hold a hearing June 19 on opening local power markets to competition, a spokeswoman for committee chairman Rep. Dan Schaefer said Tuesday.
Schaefer, a Colorado Republican, said he wanted to hold a few more hearings in his subcomittee before bringing his electric competition bill up for a vote in his panel possibly in July.
The bill would require states to break up electric utility monopolies by the end of 2000.

House lawmakers held nine hearings on electric deregulation in the last Congress and recently completed four field hearings. Schaefer said he wanted to hold at least one more hearing to "make sure we've covered every base."
